name: High-Growth SaaS Enterprise Hunter
description: Multi-channel sequence targeting VP/CROs at Series A-C SaaS companies. Combines AI research, personalized email, LinkedIn touchpoints, and conversational voice qualification.

steps.details: Scrapes recent news, funding announcements, tech stack, and generates personalized icebreakers.
Reference recent company milestone or hiring trigger. Deliverability score > 95% required.
Connect with personalized note (<300 chars) referencing company expansion.

steps.action: Aircall Sales Call: Inbox to Ringtone
steps.details: Triggers Aircall dialler with previous email/LinkedIn context pop. AI live script + one-click automatic follow-ups.
Sends ROI case study and instant calendar booking link if unbooked.

name: DevOps & Engineering Inbound/Outbound Sprint
description: High-signal sequence for CTOs and VPs of Engineering focusing on technical architecture and zero-friction developer trials.

steps.details: Identifies Kubernetes/Cloud providers and developer tooling pain points.
Focus on latency, cost optimization, and developer productivity.
Contextual comment followed by connection note.
Aircall sales dial with engineer architecture battlecard and one-click trial provisioning.

name: Aircall Speed-to-Lead: Inbox to Ringtone
description: High-velocity sales workflow. Bridges email opens and LinkedIn acceptances into instant Aircall ringtones with pre-loaded AI objection scripts.

steps.details: Personalized email referencing prospect funding/milestone with tracked demo link.

steps.delay: Auto-Triggered within 5 mins of Email Open
steps.details: Rings rep Aircall phone. Pops screen with email opened, bio, and live AI opening bridge.
Auto-dispatches LinkedIn message referencing the Aircall phone conversation.
AI-drafted recap email with confirmed Google Meet invite link dispatched without breaking rep flow.
